sanskrit_verse:
आध्यादीनां विहर्तारं धनिने दापयेद् धनम् ।
दण्डं च तत्समं राज्ञे शक्त्यपेक्षमथापि वा ॥२.२६
transliteration: ādhyādīnāṃ vihartāraṃ dhanine dāpayed dhanam / daṇḍaṃ ca tatsamaṃ rājñe śaktyapekṣam athāpi vā // YajñS_2.26
sph_interpretive_translation: One who squanders another's wealth acquired through rightful effort shall restore equivalent value to the owner; likewise, a penalty equal in measure shall be rendered unto the sovereign, adjusted according to capacity.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides inherently in the sovereign as representative of Dharma
Causation arises from conscious act of misappropriation
Restoration logic mandates equivalence without punitive intent
Consciousness alignment requires acknowledgment of ownership integrity
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent A diverts resource R belonging to agent B THEN A MUST return quantitatively equivalent value TO B
IF diversion causes systemic loss THEN penalty OF equal magnitude SHALL be directed TO sovereign authority
IF agent lacks means for immediate compensation THEN schedule RESTORATION based ON demonstrated earning capacity
ALL transactions SHALL maintain record OF origin and destination FOR adjudication clarity
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this verse establishes that financial misconduct involving private assets necessitates full reparative action by the offender while ensuring state interests are upheld through calibrated sanctions aligned with societal capacity rather than punitive excess.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals cause-effect linkage between misuse and corrective duty; anupūrvaśaḥ shows sequential unfolding from error to restoration; proportional duty aligns with individual capacity; non-punitive reality rule affirms correction stems from alignment, not vengeance.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate asset tracing and valuation process within 48 hours
Assign completion timeline based on debtor’s income-generating ability
Facilitate third-party mediation to ensure voluntary compliance
Deploy consciousness-realigning inquiry to reaffirm ethical boundaries
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed: Wealth belongs to its creator, misplacement invokes restoration, sovereignty maintains order, all enacted solely for consciousness elevation — Dharma is restored, reality remains non-punitive, and consciousness alone is the ultimate adjudicator.
